title: Page 2
content_zh:
跟在经理身后，文景瑞没有要见大人物的紧张或兴奋之情，反而有股快要压抑不住的恨意，等面孔，彷佛是未来之镜，眼前严肃、五官透露着凌厉气息的老人，看着就像四十年后的自己。

压下对眼前老人的憎恨之情，文景瑞展露应对客户的那套模式，微笑道：“前辈唤晚辈来，不知有什么需要帮忙的地方？”口吻亲切，也客套到了极点。

文传鑫看着长得酷似自己年轻时的孙子，心情十分复杂，但更多的是欣慰—— 文家子孙就是该这般优秀。

他的独子文渊华遗传到妻子的美貌，是名温文儒雅的美男子，一点也没有遗传到他的霸气凌厉，反而是这个不在他期待中出生的孙子，不只是五官肖似自己，性格上的强势、对功成名就的渴求，以及做事情的手段，在在像极了他。

想他一个没有任何背景的华人青年，居然能够成为位于义大利的游艇集团首脑，这样的能力、魄力，可说是万中选一。

“你爸的忌日到了，你给他上香了没？”文传鑫问道。提起早逝的独子，他神情难掩白发人送黑发人的哀痛。

“文老先生说笑了，我从小就没有父亲。”文景瑞在老人面前态度不卑不亢，他语气和善，可回应的内容却让人无法亲近他分毫。

“你终究姓文，是文家人，你爸也走两年了，你去上炷香吧，算是认祖归宗，往后我走了，文家的一切都是你的。还有啊，你都几岁了？还不快点定下来，生下文家长孙，传宗接代……”无视孙子的话，文传鑫自顾自的道。

认祖归宗，将文家偌大的家业留给自己？文景瑞听了只觉得好笑，那讥讽的笑容毫不掩饰地挂在嘴角，他抛开温和的面具，视线锐利地盯着眼前的老人，想着他果然是年纪大了，连自己说过的话都不记得了。

在他那个多情又滥情的父亲的第三任妻子传出怀了男孩的消息后，眼前的老人就将他叫到跟前来，用着高高在上，彷佛看什么恶心虫子般的厌恶眼神盯着他警告道——

“让你姓文已是对你最大的宽容，不要妄想本就不属于你的东西，你弟弟才是文家的继承人。”

怎么，现在要留给他了？要他认祖归宗了？可是怎么办呢，现在的他怎会将文家产业放在眼底。

“文家就剩你一人，你要负起责任，快生个儿子继承香火！”年过七十的文传鑫，事业江山掌握在手中，什么都不缺了，最在意的便是已逝独子的血脉还能不能延续。

他想看见曾孙，想亲手抱一抱软软的、小小的孩子……

“我有个老友，孙女刚从英国完成学业回来，年龄跟你相当，我安排你们见个面，以结婚为前提交往吧。”

第1章(2)

给你三分颜色便开起染房来了。文景瑞心想。这老头不只忘了自己说过的话，更完完全全忘了上回的见面是如何不欢而散。

“我再说一次，我的事你管不着。”

文景瑞很清楚这个人为何会重新将心思放在他身上，因为两年前，他的生父文渊华一家出国旅游，却不幸遭遇飞机失事而丧生，包括那同父异母，小他十八岁的弟弟。

等文家真的后继无人了，才想到他这个从来就不受欢迎的孩子，文景瑞只觉得好笑，对着眼前的老人下最后通牒——

“看在文渊华三十多年前的精血之恩，我再给你最后一次面子，也是最后一次告诉你，我文景瑞跟你们文家没有半点关系，你若再对我指手画脚，就别怪我对你不客气，区区一个文氏金控我还不放在眼里。”他冷冷的道。

文传鑫听到这近似恐吓的话语，严肃的五官不但不见半分怒意，反而兴奋不已，认为这样剽悍的性格才是文家人，他越看越觉得这个孙子顺眼，越想要他继承文氏金控，再为文家生下数个肖似自己的曾孙。

“别再来烦我。”文景瑞说完，转头便走。

看着文景瑞跟自己年轻时相似的脾气，文传鑫越看越是心痒，他以前怎么会觉得这孩子的母亲出身上不了台面，而早早把他打发出去呢？

思及文景瑞的生母，他顿时心念一动。

“等等！你生个孩子，无论男女，只要让他姓文，让他喊我曾祖父，文家的一切就都是他的，你爸爸留下来的也都给他。还有，我会把你母亲迁进文家祖坟，跟你父亲葬在一起。”

听到最后一句，文景瑞停下脚步，转过身，满是嘲讽的神情消失，换上的是严肃凌厉，他握紧拳头，瞪着这该死的老人。

辛苦拉拔他长大，在他十四岁那年操劳过度而去世的母亲，是文景瑞唯一的弱点。

而母亲生前心心念念的便是父亲，她最大也是最卑微的心愿—— 生前她无法跟父亲成为夫妻，希望起码死后能成为文家媳妇，与父亲合葬。

当年他来到文家，哀求着让母亲葬进文家祖坟，文传鑫只有简单三个字，“凭什么？”

快二十年了，母亲的遗愿一直放在文景瑞心中，本以为他这一生都不可能完成了，可老头却松了口，愿意让母亲成为文家人，条件是要满足他的私心……

文景瑞有权有钱，想要的东西都能轻易得手，唯独让母亲迁入文家祖坟，让文家承认她这件事情，他无法用财富或权势办到。

他深深、深深地凝视文传鑫良久，而后头也不回的离开。

哒哒的马蹄声快速而规律，伴随着擦过颊边的呼呼风声，文景瑞轻扯缰绳，跑了数圈的马儿嘶鸣一声，步伐渐缓，最终停了下来，它不耐烦地喷气，在马场边缘来回踱步。

意识到自己烦躁的情绪感染到了爱马，文景瑞歉意满满地抚摸着时光的颈子，轻声安抚，待马儿情绪平复，他跨下马背，马场工作人员立刻过来协助，却被他制止了，迳自牵着躁动的时光往专属马厩而去。

通常他策马奔驰数圈后，烦躁的心情、紧迫的工作压力都会随之化解，可如今连最爱的马术运动也无法排解他的烦闷。

“一个孩子，哈。”他冷笑出声。

文景瑞一点也不在乎文家的产业将会留给谁，他在乎的是已过世的母亲至今仍孤孤单单的待在灵骨塔里，而他只要生下属于他的孩子，就能让母亲迁进文家祖坟，与父亲合葬。

生个孩子不难，相信愿意生他孩子的女人可以从台湾头排队到台湾尾，再不济也可以到欧美找个代理孕母交差了事。

可他从小便是个父不详的孩子，自然不愿意自己的孩子在父母非婚姻关系的状态下出生，即使离婚，他也希望孩子知道自己的双亲是什么人、随时能见面，而不是跟他一样，饱受被同侪嘲笑奚落的滋味。

“要去哪里找个身体健康、人品佳，愿意生下我的小孩后拿钱离婚的女人啊？”文景瑞思考着他孩子的妈该具备的条件。

想想也可笑，一个人品好的女人又怎么会肯拿了他的钱短暂嫁给他，等生下小孩后离婚呢？

他不禁失笑，觉得自己真是太异想天开了，边摇着头边牵着时光往前走去，就在快靠近马厩时，他听见有人说话的声音。

“外公，希恩病了，需要钱……”一个虚弱，正在苦苦哀求的女性嗓音传进他耳中。
content_en:
Following the manager, Wen Jingrui didn't feel nervous or excited about meeting a big shot. Instead, he felt an almost irrepressible hatred. His face seemed to be a mirror of the future. The serious old man in front of him with sharp features looked like himself forty years later.

Suppressing his hatred for the old man in front of him, Wen Jingrui showed his usual way of dealing with customers and said with a smile: "Senior has called for junior. Is there anything I need help with?" His tone was cordial and polite to the extreme.

Wen Chuanxin looked at his grandson who looked exactly like him when he was young. He felt very complicated, but more importantly, he was happy - the descendants of the Wen family should be so outstanding.

His only son, Wen Yuanhua, inherited his wife's beauty. He was a gentle and elegant handsome man. He did not inherit his domineering power at all. On the contrary, this grandson, who was born unexpectedly, not only resembled him in facial features, but also in his strong character, desire for success, and method of doing things.

To think that a Chinese young man with no background could actually become the head of a yacht group in Italy. Such ability and courage can be said to be one of ten thousand.

"It's your father's death anniversary. Have you offered incense to him?" Wen Chuanxin asked.When he mentioned his only son who died young, his expression could not hide the sadness of a man with white hair sending a man with black hair to grief.

"Old Mr. Wen was joking, I haven't had a father since I was a child." Wen Jingrui's attitude in front of the old man was neither humble nor overbearing. His tone was kind, but the content of his response made it impossible to get close to him at all.

"After all, your surname is Wen, and you belong to the Wen family. Your father has been gone for two years. You go and burn incense, which is considered as acknowledging your ancestors. After I leave, everything in the Wen family will be yours. And, how old are you? Why don't you decide quickly, give birth to Wen's grandson, and carry on the family line..." Ignoring his grandson's words, Wen Chuanxin said to himself.

Acknowledge your ancestors and return to your clan, leaving the Wen family’s huge fortune to yourself?Wen Jingrui only found it funny when he heard that. The sarcastic smile hung on the corner of his mouth without any concealment. He put aside his gentle mask and stared sharply at the old man in front of him, thinking that he was really old and didn't even remember what he said.

After the news came out that the third wife of his passionate and sentimental father was pregnant with a boy, the old man in front of him called him over, stared at him with a look of disgust as if looking at some disgusting insect, and warned him——

"Letting your surname be Wen is the greatest tolerance for you. Don't think about things that don't belong to you. Your brother is the heir to the Wen family."

What, now it’s left to him?Do you want him to recognize his ancestor and return to his clan?But what to do? How could he put the Wen family's property in his eyes now?

"You are the only one left in the Wen family. You must take responsibility and give birth to a son as soon as possible to carry on the legacy!" Wen Chuanxin, who is over seventy years old, has his career in his hands and lacks nothing. What he cares most about is whether the bloodline of his deceased only son can continue.

He wanted to see his great-grandson and hold a soft, little child in his arms...

"I have an old friend. Her granddaughter has just returned from studying in the UK. She is about the same age as you. I will arrange for you to meet and start a relationship with the precondition of marriage."

Chapter 1(2)

I'll open the dyeing room after giving you three points of color.Wen Jingrui thought to himself.Not only did the old man forget what he had said, but he also completely forgot how the last meeting ended on bad terms.

"I'll say it again, you have nothing to do with me."

Wen Jingrui knew very well why this person put his attention on him again, because two years ago, his biological father, Wen Yuanhua, and his family traveled abroad, but unfortunately they were killed in a plane crash, including his half-brother, who was eighteen years younger than him.

When the Wen family really had no heirs, they thought of him, a child who had never been popular. Wen Jingrui only found it funny and gave an ultimatum to the old man in front of him——

"For the sake of Wen Yuanhua's kindness more than thirty years ago, I will give you one last favor, and I will also tell you for the last time that I, Wen Jingrui, have nothing to do with your Wen family. If you continue to point fingers at me, don't blame me for being rude to you. I will not look down on a mere financial controller of the Wen family." He said coldly.

When Wen Chuanxin heard these threatening words, his serious features showed no trace of anger, but excitement. He believed that such a fierce character was the Wen family. The more he looked at him, the more he liked this grandson, and the more he wanted him to inherit the Wen family's financial holdings and give birth to several great-grandchildren for the Wen family who looked like himself.

"Don't bother me again." After Wen Jingrui said that, he turned around and left.

Seeing Wen Jingrui's temper similar to his own when he was young, Wen Chuanxin became more and more itchy. How could he have thought that this child's mother was not worthy of the spotlight, yet sent her away so early?

Thinking of Wen Jingrui's biological mother, he suddenly had a thought.

"Wait a minute! If you give birth to a child, no matter male or female, as long as his surname is Wen and he is called my great-grandfather, everything in the Wen family will be his, and everything left by your father will be given to him. Also, I will move your mother to the Wen family's ancestral grave and bury it with your father."

Hearing the last sentence, Wen Jingrui stopped and turned around. His mocking expression disappeared and was replaced by a serious one. He clenched his fists and glared at the damn old man.

Wen Jingrui's mother, who worked hard to bring him up and died of overwork when he was fourteen, is Wen Jingrui's only weakness.

What my mother cared about most during her lifetime was her father. Her biggest and humblest wish was that she could not marry her father during her lifetime. She hoped that she could at least become the wife of the Wen family and be buried with her father after her death.

When he came to the Wen family and begged for his mother to be buried in the Wen family's ancestral grave, Wen Chuanxin could only say three simple words, "Why?"

For nearly twenty years, his mother's last wish has been in Wen Jingrui's heart. He thought he would never be able to fulfill it in his life, but the old man relented and was willing to let his mother become a member of the Wen family, on the condition that his selfishness be satisfied...

Wen Jingrui had power and money and could easily get whatever he wanted. The only thing he could not do with his wealth or power was to move his mother into the Wen family's ancestral grave and have the Wen family recognize her.

He stared at Wen Chuanxin deeply and deeply for a long time, and then left without looking back.

The sound of the horse's hoofbeats was fast and regular, accompanied by the whistling wind that brushed against his cheeks. Wen Jingrui pulled the reins lightly, and the horse neighed after running for several laps. The pace gradually slowed down and finally stopped. It snorted impatiently and paced back and forth on the edge of the racecourse.

Realizing that his irritability had infected his beloved horse, Wen Jingrui apologetically stroked Shiguang's neck and softly comforted him. When the horse calmed down, he got off the horse. The racecourse staff immediately came to assist, but he stopped him and led the restless Shiji to the exclusive stable.

Usually, after riding his horse for a few laps, his irritable mood and urgent work pressure would be relieved, but now even his favorite equestrian sport could not relieve his boredom.

"A kid, ha." He sneered.

Wen Jingrui didn't care at all about who the Wen family's property would be left to. What he cared about was that his deceased mother was still alone in the ossuary tower. As long as he gave birth to his child, he could have his mother move into the Wen family's ancestral grave and be buried with his father.

It is not difficult to give birth to a child. I believe that women who are willing to give birth to his child can queue from the beginning to the end of Taiwan. Even if it is not possible, they can find a surrogate mother in Europe and the United States.

But he has been a child with an unknown father since he was a child. Naturally, he does not want his child to be born in a non-marital relationship between his parents. Even if they are divorced, he also hopes that the child will know who his parents are and be able to meet them at any time, instead of suffering the same feeling of being ridiculed by his peers like him.

"Where can I find a woman who is healthy, has good character, and is willing to pay for a divorce after giving birth to my child?" Wen Jingrui thought about the conditions that the mother of his child should have.

It's ridiculous to think about it. How could a woman with good character be willing to take his money to marry him for a short period of time and then divorce her after giving birth to a child?

He couldn't help but laugh, feeling that he was so whimsical. He shook his head and walked forward with time. Just as he was approaching the stable, he heard someone's voice.

"Grandpa, Sheen is sick and needs money..." A weak, pleading female voice reached his ears.
